entries.back_en: This book details the history of the Empire from the First Emperor Fou-Lu to the Fourth Emperor Temul.
You found a list of all the people who were used as sacrifices for the Carronade...
You found a report of the Empire's attempt to summon a god and what went wrong.
You found records of experiments with different methods to kill dragons and other gods.
There are many scrolls and books written in ancient languages on the shelves.
